commitResults.messageTitle: Allow editing task and event details while keeping IDs fixed
commitResults.messageBody:
Users need to correct a task or reschedule an event without deleting and recreating it, which would change its ID and lose a task's completion state.

ScheduledItem now keeps id and project final and lets description and date change together through updateDetails. Both new values are validated before either field is assigned, so a failed edit leaves the item unchanged. Task and Event expose package-private edit methods so changes go through ProjectManager.

ProjectManager gains editTask, editEvent and getEvent. getEvent mirrors the existing getTask lookup. Edits do not advance ID counters because no new item is created.
